title: RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026 Out, Zone Wise Merit List PDF (CEN 02/2025), Cut Off Marks
fullContentHtml:
The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026 on 29th May at the official website https://www.rrbcdg.gov.in/ or other regional candidates. A total of 15 lakh candidates have appeared for the Computer Based Exam on 6th, 9th and 10th March, can now check and download the merit list pdf and scorecard for respective zone. In order to download the RRB Technician Grade III Scorecard 2026, candidate need to login using the Registration Number and Date of Birth at rrb.digialm.com. Scroll down to get complete information related to the RRB Technician Merit List PDF, Scorecard, Cut Off Marks Zone Wise.

Free Railway Exam Current Affairs Booklet 2026 PDF: Click to Download

RRB Technician Grade III Result 2026 Out

Is RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026 Out or not? Yes, the RRB Technician Result 2026 is finally out on 29th May at the official website https://www.rrbcdg.gov.in/. Along with the result, the Railway Recruitment Board has also uploaded the merit list pdf, cut off marks for each zones such as RRB Ahmedabad, RRB Ajmer, RRB Bengaluru, RRB Bhopal, RRB Bhubaneswar, RRB Bilaspur, RRB Chandigarh, RRB Chennai, RRB Gorakhpur, RRB Guwahati, RRB Jammu-Srinagar, RRB Kolkata, RRB Malda, RRB Mumbai, RRB Muzaffarpur, RRB Patna, RRB Prayagraj, RRB Ranchi, RRB Secunderabad, RRB Siliguri, and RRB Thiruvananthapuram. All the qualified candidates that got named in the merit list are now going to appear for the Document Verification. Bookmark this page for all the updates related to the RRB Technician Grade III Result 2026.

Note: The RRB Technician Grade III Scorecard 2026 Link has been activated on 29th May. The direct link has been provided below in the article.

RRB Technician Result CEN 02/2025

As per CEN 02/2025, the Railway Recruitment is announced to recruit 6055 Grade 3 Technician across mechanical, electrical, civil, workshop, and technical maintenance streams. The major Grade III specialisations include Track Machine, Blacksmith, Bridge, Carriage and Wagon, Diesel Electrical, Diesel Mechanical, Electrical/TRS, Electrical GS, Electrical TRD, EMU, Fitter, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning, Riveter, S&T, Welder, Crane Driver, Carpenter, Machinist, Mechanical, Millwright, Painter, Trimmer, and workshop-based electrical, diesel, fitter, mechanical, and welder roles. Now, the recruitment is in its final stage, as the CBT Exam Result has been announced. Check the below table for complete information related to the RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2025-26.

RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026

The RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026 PDF has been released for candidates who appeared in the Technician Grade III Signal CBT under CEN 02/2025. The result is available in PDF format, containing the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates separately for each region. The official announcement of the RRB Technician 2026 Result has been made across all regional RRB websites simultaneously.

Till now, 0nly RRB Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Bilaspur, Gorakhpur, Jammu, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Siliguri, Bhubaneswar, Ajmer, Thiruvananthapuram, Secunderbad, Ranchi, Chennai and Prayagraj has uploaded the RRB Technician Grade III Result 2026, keep refreshing the page for latest updates.

RRB Technician Grade 3 Merit List 2026 PDF Zone Wise

The RRB Technician Merit List is a zone specific document that lists the roll numbers of all candidates who have cleared the Computer-Based Test successfully. Since each RRB zone operates as an independent recruitment unit, the merit lists are uploaded on regional websites rather than a single central file. Candidates must download the PDF for the specific zone they applied to during the registration process. The RRB Technician Result for each zone shows the competition level & vacancy count of that particular region.

Steps to Check the RRB Technician Result 2026 at rrbcdg.gov.in

Step 1: Visit the official regional Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) website, for example, https://www.rrbcdg.gov.in/ for RRB Chandigarh.

Step 2: Click on the TECHNICIAN GRADE III – CEN 02/2025 LIST OF CANDIDATES SHORTLISTED FOR DOCUMENT VERIFICATION & MEDICAL EXAMINATION on the homepage or result section.

Step 3: Click the link to open the merit list PDF in the browser.

Step 4: Submit the details carefully.

Step 5: Use the ‘Ctrl+F’ function & type roll number to see if candidates are selected.

Step 6: Enter the Registration Number & Password (DOB). Step 7: Download the scorecard and take a printout for Document Verification and future reference.

RRB Technician Grade 3 Cut Off 2026 Out: Click to Check

RRB Technician Grade III Scorecard 2026 Download Link Active [rrb.digialm.com]

The RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 link has been activated on 29th May the official website rrb.digialm.com. The scorecard is a document that shows the actual marks, score & the qualifying status for the next round. Unlike the general merit list the scorecard needs individual login credentials like registration number & date of birth. As per the RRB Technician Grade III result notice, the scorecard download facility will remain available only up to 16th June 2026, so candidates are advised to download and save their scorecard before the last date. Shortlisted candidates must also keep track of the DV e-call letter and further instructions related to Document Verification and Medical Examination. The direct link to download the RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 PDF Link has been updated below.

RRB Technician Scorecard 2026 Link Active: Click to Download

Note: Candidates shortlisted for Document Verification and Medical Examination should download their scorecard and keep it safely for future reference during the recruitment process.

Detail Mentioned on the RRB Technician Scorecard 2026

Candidates should verify all personal details on the RRB Technician Grade III scorecard so that there are no clerical errors. If candidates find any mistakes in the RRB Technician Result details one should contact the board immediately.

  • Candidate Name: The full name as per the registration form.
  • Registration Number: The unique ID for the CEN 02/2025 recruitment.
  • Normalized Score: The score based on the difficulty of the specific exam shift.
  • Proportional Score: Score calculated out of 100 valid questions.
  • Shortlist Status: A “Yes” or “No” indicating the eligibility for Document Verification.
  • Zone & Post: The specific RRB zone & the technician grade applied for.

RRB Technician Grade 3 Cut Off 2026

The RRB Technician Cut Off marks are the minimum scores needed by a candidate to qualify for the next stage of the selection process. The marks are decided based on the number of vacancies in a zone, the difficulty of the question paper & the total number of applicants. The cut-off is released category-wise meaning the passing marks for UR, OBC, SC & ST candidates will differ.

What After RRB Technician Result 2026?

After the declaration of the RRB Technician Result the shortlisted candidates must prepare for the process of Document Verification (DV). During this stage officials will check the original educational certificates, caste certificates & identity proofs. Failure to provide original documents can lead to disqualification regardless of the score in the RRB Technician 2026 Result. Once the DV is complete the candidates are sent for a medical fitness test in railway hospitals so that they meet the visual & physical standards for technical work.

  • Document Verification: Bring all original certificates & 2 sets of photocopies
  • Medical Exam: Pass the ‘A-3’ or ‘B-1’ medical standard test as per post
  • Final Panel: A final list of selected candidates is sent to the respective railway divisions
  • Training: Undergo a training period where the candidates learn about railway safety & technical systems.
  • Appointment: Receive the joining letter & start the career as a Railway Technician.
